style: Powerful strategic cinematic battle score for a war of wits in a kingdom of rust. Deliberate heavy taiko and orchestral bass drum hits, ticking clockwork and metal percussion, relentless low string and cello ostinato, massive low brass and trombone chords, a commanding French horn theme doubled by strings, deep warm analog bass. Calculated, confident and weighty; slow-building tactical tension that lands with full orchestral power, earthy copper tones. Entirely instrumental: empty vocal part, no lyrics, singing, choir, humming or speech. Evolving instrumental arrangement, clear melodic development, spacious ending. Dm, 108 BPM.
